sentences.span: Non-farm payrolls increased by 162,000, of which private payrolls contributed 127,000, compared with consensus expectations for 55,000. Positive revisions added a further 55,000 jobs to prior months.
sentences.why: Every figure matches exactly: headline 162k, private 127k, consensus 55k, revisions +55k.

sentences.span: This was generally read as "hawkish". Was it? ... if one thinks core inflation decelerates ... Morgan Stanley Economists forecast the Fed stays on hold.
sentences.why: Synthesizing framing sentence; sources show real dispersion on Fed-chair reaction (MS holds, GS/BofA hike, DB underpriced) while CPI data forecasts across banks are close together — accurately characterizes the actual split.

sentences.span: the ISM services prices paid component ... it's at a 4-year high and was consistent with CPI above 5% in the last inflation wave ... Jim Reid | September 2026 ... Deutsche Bank
sentences.why: DB chartbook (Jim Reid) makes exactly this argument with the same figures.

sentences.span: We expect a 0.23% increase in August core CPI (vs. +0.2% consensus)
sentences.why: GS US Daily CPI preview, exact figure and month match.

sentences.span: we forecast core CPI to rise a trend-like 0.22% m/m in August and core PCE to increase 0.24% m/m
sentences.why: BofA Trading Catalysts note, exact figures match.

sentences.span: the 30yr yield 1m avg is north of 5.2% for the first time (in earnest) since 2003
sentences.why: Combined with GS Kaplan note ('long-end yields around 5% looked reasonable, with risk premia due to Fed uncertainty, energy-driven inflation, and less effective bond hedging' — pilot-data/.../15525__gs-kaplan-back-to-school-checklist-3-sep-2026.txt); both GS sources, figures and rationale match.

sentences.span: the front-end future rose +3.46% to €75.80/MWh ... storage ... only 67% full ... storage was 79% full in 2025
sentences.why: DB Reid macro strategy note, all figures match exactly.

sentences.span: we have raised our 4Q26 forecasts to $100/bbl for Brent oil, and €88/MWh for Natural Gas ... our US Equity Strategists think Energy Equities offer an attractive hedge.
sentences.why: MS note matches forecast levels and the energy-equities-as-hedge call exactly.

sentences.span: realized correlation across S&P over the last 6 months is 11, only two periods in the last 25yrs have seen this
sentences.why: GS Duttenhoefer daily, figure matches exactly.

sentences.span: US L/S Gross leverage rose +1.5 pts to 208.5% (27th percentile one-year), while US L/S Net leverage increased +0.9 pts to 48.4% (4th percentile one-year)
sentences.why: GS Positioning Mondays note, all three figures (208.5%/27th, 48.4%/4th) match; top-of-note summary also labels this metric 'US Fundamental HFs' Net Leverage ... 4% percentile'.

sentences.span: We project the Q3 blackout window to begin around September 15, when roughly 40% of the S&P 500 will enter their quiet periods.
sentences.why: Matches near-verbatim across three separate desk notes (GS Kaplan, GS Share Repurchase Recap, GS Luey EU vol commentary).

sentences.span: Oracle reports 1Q27 results on Thursday, September 10th.
sentences.why: 1Q27 = Oracle's fiscal first quarter; date and framing match.

sentences.span: increased borrowing by Oracle whose debt to equity ratio was already 500% compared to 50% for Amazon, 30% for Microsoft ... Oracle's stock and credit spreads sold off sharply
sentences.why: JPM Eye on the Market (Cembalest); figures and the 'sold off since that call' framing both match, referring to Oracle (subject carried from s12/s14 context).

sentences.span: we are focused on three areas: (1) data center capacity deployment and the pace of RPO conversation to revenues, (2) capital expenditures and funding requirements
sentences.why: BofA Trading Catalysts note; 'contracted backlog' = RPO, 'funding plan' = funding requirements — matches the two lead focus areas for Oracle's print.

sentences.span: SPX options are pricing just a 0.82% post-election move ... BofA prefers a VIX calendar call-spread collar, selling the October 16 put and buying the November 22–30 call spread
sentences.why: Matches exactly, duplicated verbatim in a second file (15632); collar structure confirms the put leg is on VIX.
